Overview

Budapest is a city in Budapest with a population of 1,752,286. The Pearl of the Danube, a stunning capital with Art Nouveau architecture, thermal baths, a vibrant ruin bar scene, and one of Europe’s most beautiful parliament buildings. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
